title: The Architects of New Jack Swing
theme: The late-80s and early-90s bridge between synth-funk and modern R&B. Drum machines, aggressive swing, and high-energy choreography.
narrativePurpose: Test players on the foundational movement that merged hip-hop attitude with R&B melodies, defining the sound of an entire generation.
toneProgression: Massive dancefloor anthems → The producers and solo breakouts → Studio origins and group lineages

vault.note: Digit 4 (index 3) is always visible. Vault code 1-9-8-8 — the year Bobby Brown's Don't Be Cruel sold seven million copies and announced New Jack Swing as the future of R&B. Keith Sweat and Johnny Kemp confirmed it the same year. The drum machine had taken command.

rounds.name: RADIO HITS
rounds.description: The heavy-hitting dancefloor anthems that defined the era. Identify the groups and solo stars that took New Jack Swing mainstream.

questions.question: Which 1988 Bobby Brown album — selling over seven million copies in the US — is considered the commercial peak of New Jack Swing?

metadata.fact: Don't Be Cruel debuted at #1 on the Billboard 200 in 1988 and spawned five Top 10 singles including 'My Prerogative,' 'Don't Be Cruel,' and 'Every Little Step.' It remains the defining commercial artifact of the New Jack Swing era.
metadata.storyHook: Never trust a big butt and a smile.
metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: Don't Be Cruel is Bobby Brown's 1988 second studio album on MCA Records; US sales certified 8x Platinum (RIAA). 'Over seven million' in the US is accurate.

questions.question: Which Bobby Brown anthem, produced by Teddy Riley, became the ultimate New Jack Swing declaration of independence in 1988?

metadata.fact: The track hit #1 on the Billboard Hot 100, cementing Bobby Brown's status as a solo megastar after leaving New Edition.
metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: 'My Prerogative' produced by Teddy Riley; confirmed by multiple sources including Focusrite interview with Riley.

sources.title: Sound on Sound – In the studio with Teddy Riley

questions.question: Keith Sweat's 1987 debut single 'I Want Her' — widely considered one of the first major New Jack Swing records — appeared on which debut album?
choices: I'll Give All My Love to You

metadata.fact: Make It Last Forever was released on Vintertainment/Elektra Records in 1987 — produced by Teddy Riley, it is widely credited as one of the first albums to define the New Jack Swing production template.
metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: 'I Want Her' is the debut single from Keith Sweat's 1987 debut album Make It Last Forever, widely cited as an early New Jack Swing record.

questions.question: Johnny Kemp's legendary 1988 weekend anthem 'Just Got Paid' was an instrumental originally intended for which artist?

metadata.fact: Teddy Riley originally offered the track to Keith Sweat, but when Sweat passed, Johnny Kemp recorded it and scored a #1 R&B hit.
metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: 'Just Got Paid' (1988) was originally a Teddy Riley instrumental intended for Keith Sweat's debut album Make It Last Forever. Sweat passed on it. Sources: Wikipedia, Rolling Stone obituary for Kemp.

sources.title: Just Got Paid (Johnny Kemp song) – Wikipedia
Rolling Stone – Johnny Kemp, 'Just Got Paid' Singer, Dead at 55

questions.question: Which rap duo, heavily associated with the New Jack Swing movement, released the massive 1992 hit 'Rump Shaker'?

metadata.fact: The group was formed by Teddy Riley's brother Markell Riley and Aqil Davidson. 'Rump Shaker' peaked at #2 on the Hot 100.
metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: Wreckx-N-Effect were heavily associated with New Jack Swing and released 'Rump Shaker' (1992).

questions.question: Which former New Edition lead singer struck solo gold with the 1990 Jam & Lewis-produced hit 'Sensitivity'?

metadata.fact: The track spent 20 weeks on the Billboard Hot 100 and successfully established Ralph Tresvant outside of New Edition.
metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: Ralph Tresvant is a former New Edition lead singer who had a solo hit in 1990 produced by Jimmy Jam & Terry Lewis.

questions.question: Bell Biv DeVoe's 1990 debut album — which gave New Jack Swing its defining pop crossover moment — was titled what?

bonus.bonusHint: DIGIT 1 OF 3 — BBD'S DEBUT ALBUM TITLE

metadata.fact: Poison was released on MCA Records in 1990 and went quadruple-platinum — its blend of New Jack Swing production with rap-influenced attitude defined the genre's crossover potential and the album became one of the best-selling R&B records of the decade.
metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: Bell Biv DeVoe's 1990 debut album was titled Poison; it defined the New Jack Swing group sound post-New Edition.

reserve.question: Which artist had a massive hit with the New Jack Swing ballad 'Nite and Day' in 1988?

metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: Al B. Sure! had a hit with 'Nite and Day' (1988), a New Jack Swing ballad on Warner Bros.

reserve.question: Tony! Toni! Toné! embraced the New Jack Swing tempo with which energetic 1990 hit?

metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: 'Feels Good' is a Tony! Toni! Toné! single from 1990.

reserve.question: Heavy D & The Boyz delivered a global New Jack Swing hit in 1991 with a cover of which O'Jays song?

metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: 'Now That We Found Love' is a 1991 Heavy D & The Boyz hit.

reserve.question: Which R&B group released the massive New Jack Swing hit 'Spread My Wings' in 1989?

metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: 'Spread My Wings' is a Troop single associated with the New Jack Swing era.

rounds.name: DEEP CUTS
rounds.description: The producers behind the boards, the label politics, and the lineage of the greatest New Jack Swing groups.

questions.question: After the initial dissolution of Guy, Teddy Riley co-wrote and produced which massive 1992 Wreckx-N-Effect hit that became a New Jack Swing anthem?

metadata.fact: 'Rump Shaker' peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1993 and spent multiple weeks at #1 on the R&B chart — co-written and produced by Teddy Riley, it bridged New Jack Swing's energy with the emerging bass-heavy sound of early 90s urban radio.
metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: After Guy's initial dissolution, Teddy Riley co-wrote and produced 'Rump Shaker' for Wreckx-n-Effect (1992), one of the first records made at Future Recording Studios.

questions.question: Jimmy Jam & Terry Lewis crafted which iconic 1989 Janet Jackson album that heavily utilized the aggressive, industrial drum sounds of New Jack Swing?

metadata.fact: 'Rhythm Nation 1814' produced a record-breaking seven top-five singles on the Billboard Hot 100.
metadata.storyHook: They didn't just make an album; they made a militant, highly choreographed movement.
metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: Rhythm Nation 1814 (1989) is the Janet Jackson album produced by Jimmy Jam & Terry Lewis.

questions.question: Michael Jackson completely modernized his sound by hiring Teddy Riley to co-produce the bulk of which 1991 album?

metadata.fact: Teddy Riley co-produced huge tracks like 'Remember the Time' and 'In the Closet', making 'Dangerous' one of the best-selling albums of all time.
metadata.storyHook: When the King of Pop needed to sound like the streets, he made one phone call to the King of New Jack Swing.
metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: Michael Jackson hired Teddy Riley to co-produce Dangerous (1991), modernizing his sound with New Jack Swing elements.

questions.question: Which Minneapolis R&B group — known for 'Breaking My Heart (Pretty Brown Eyes)' — bridged New Jack Swing with live funk instrumentation?

metadata.fact: Mint Condition — formed in Minneapolis — combined New Jack Swing's rhythmic energy with live instrumentation rather than drum machines, placing them at the intersection of NJS and the emerging neo-soul movement. 'Breaking My Heart (Pretty Brown Eyes)' reached the R&B top 10 in 1992.
metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: Mint Condition is a Minneapolis R&B group known for 'Breaking My Heart (Pretty Brown Eyes)' and their live-instrument approach to New Jack Swing.

questions.question: Tony! Toni! Toné!'s 1991 anthem — which has become one of the most enduring songs of the New Jack Swing era — was titled what?

metadata.fact: 'Anniversary' was released in 1993 from Sons of Soul and became Tony! Toni! Toné!'s most enduring hit — its classic soul arrangement, distinct from the harder-edged NJS production of the era, demonstrated the genre's stylistic range and the group's musical sophistication.
metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: 'Anniversary' is a 1991 Tony! Toni! Toné! anthem, one of the era's most enduring R&B records.

questions.question: Bobby Brown won the Grammy for Best Male R&B Vocal Performance at the 1990 ceremony for which single?

bonus.bonusHint: DIGIT 2 OF 3 — BOBBY BROWN'S GRAMMY-WINNING SINGLE

metadata.fact: 'Every Little Step' won Grammy Best Male R&B Vocal Performance at the 32nd Grammy Awards in 1990 — one of five singles from Don't Be Cruel to chart in the Top 10, it solidified Bobby Brown as the defining male voice of the New Jack Swing movement.
metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: Bobby Brown won Best Male R&B Vocal Performance at the 1990 Grammy ceremony (32nd Grammys) for 'Every Little Step.'

reserve.question: Tony! Toni! Toné! — the New Jack Swing-influenced trio known for 'Feels Good' and 'Anniversary' — were from which Bay Area city?

metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: Tony! Toni! Toné! are from Oakland, California.

reserve.question: Which New Edition member achieved massive solo success with the Jam & Lewis-produced New Jack Swing hit 'Rub You the Right Way'?

metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: Johnny Gill is a New Edition member who achieved massive solo success with production from Jimmy Jam & Terry Lewis.

reserve.question: Heavy D & the Boyz — whose energetic New Jack Swing sound was central to the Uptown Records identity — were from which New York city?

metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: Heavy D & The Boyz were from Mount Vernon, New York.

rounds.name: HIDDEN GEMS
rounds.description: The deepest architecture. Lineup shifts, exact studio geography, and the true timeline of the movement.

questions.question: Which original member of Guy left the group shortly after their debut album, leading to Damion Hall joining the lineup?

metadata.fact: Timmy Gatling co-founded Guy with Teddy Riley and Aaron Hall but left right as their 1988 debut album began taking off.
metadata.storyHook: He helped lay the foundation for an entire genre, then walked away right before the genre exploded.
metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: Timmy Gatling was an original Guy member who left after the debut album; Damion Hall replaced him. Confirmed across Wikipedia, NJS fandom, and multiple sources.

questions.question: Teddy Riley established 'Future Recording Studios' to craft his signature New Jack Swing sound. In which city was it located?

metadata.fact: Teddy Riley moved his operation from Harlem to Virginia Beach, effectively laying the groundwork for the Virginia production dynasty that would later include Timbaland and The Neptunes.
metadata.storyHook: He left the birthplace of hip-hop to build his own empire in the south, changing the geography of R&B forever.
metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: Teddy Riley established Future Recording Studios in Virginia Beach, Virginia in 1991. Studio name corrected from 'Future Records Recording Studios' in original stem.

sources.title: Red Bull Music Academy – Interview: Teddy Riley on His Virginia Years

questions.question: Janet Jackson's 'Rhythm Nation 1814' — whose New Jack Swing production by Jimmy Jam & Terry Lewis set a new standard — was released in what year?

bonus.bonusHint: DIGIT 3 OF 3 — YEAR RHYTHM NATION DROPPED

metadata.fact: Rhythm Nation 1814 was released on A&M Records on September 19, 1989 — its New Jack Swing-dominated production by Jimmy Jam & Terry Lewis yielded seven Top 5 singles, including four #1 hits, making it the first album by any artist to produce that many chart-topping singles.
metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: Janet Jackson's Rhythm Nation 1814 was released in 1989.

reserve.question: Which New Jack Swing group featured future solo star and producer Teddy Riley as a core member before he went on to form Blackstreet?

metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: Teddy Riley was a core member of Guy (1987–1990) before forming Blackstreet in 1991/1992. Guy is the foundational New Jack Swing group. Sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guy_(band), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blackstreet
metadata.hostNote: Teddy Riley is primarily known as a producer and musician; 'solo star' in the stem refers to his broader post-Guy prominence. Guy is mentioned by name in R3-Q1 — if this reserve activates late in Round 3, players may have context from that question.

reserve.question: The term 'New Jack Swing' was coined by which journalist — who also wrote the screenplay for the 1991 film 'New Jack City'?

metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: Barry Michael Cooper coined the term 'New Jack Swing' in a 1987/1988 Village Voice profile of Teddy Riley, and wrote the 1991 New Jack City screenplay. Cooper passed away January 22, 2025.
metadata.hostNote: Barry Michael Cooper passed away January 22, 2025. Frame the question matter-of-factly — the focus is his cultural contribution, not his passing.
